some
air? I need to feel the breeze.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
My apologies, but may I step outside for
some
air? I need to feel the breeze.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
It's all right, Trainer. I don't want to

inconvenience you.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Why is that? This loss was my fault and
mine
alone.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер
choice_data_list:
It's a long journey to the top. Everyone needs a
leg up now and then.

text_block_list.text:
Point taken. I'll keep climbing, so would
you lend
me your strength, Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
...I would prefer to be somewhere else if
possible.
I know it's a selfish request.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
After all the times I've returned to this
room
following a loss... just the sight of
it fills me with
frustration.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер
choice_data_list: That's exactly why we should stay.

text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер
choice_data_list: You have to confront that feeling.

text_block_list.text:
...I see. Not doing so would be running
away.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Very well. I will face this frustration now
so that I
may prevent it from befalling
me again.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Грасс Вандер's hair ripples in the
breeze as we
discuss what led to today's
defeat.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Afterwards, Грасс Вандер and I
evaluate
everything that went wrong in
today's race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
